name: Koblios
description: Author of Meditations who said the gods are simply patterns personified and was stoned for heresy.

description_citations.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Xenocrates argues that gods are the patterns mortals recognize, personified through the power of Nyx, and that mortals are responsible for their gods; Melantha forbids it as blasphemy.
timeline.quote: Through the power of Nyx, we are responsible for our gods.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.
